name: Marlowe
fantasy: The burr-and-needle marksman. Tags a foe with a clinging charge, lets the rifle and one long needle of light do the rest, and lives off every hit that lands.
silhouette: the scarf streaming behind and the bandolier of burr charges across the chest

card.loop: Burr Charge sticks and goes off, leaving a foe Rattled: slowed, and your rifle and Longneedle hit harder. Every ability you land builds Fever, a lifesteal your rifle then feeds.
card.dash: Slipstep: tap to skid 3.4m, hold to slide 6m and keep shooting; let go early and you get part of it back.
card.passive: Fever: each ability that lands adds a stack of lifesteal for 3.5s. A knock heals you and refreshes Slipstep.
card.rmb: Burr Charge: it sticks to what it hits. On a foe it pops with a Rattle; on a wall it blasts a cone back at them.
card.e: Longneedle: stand and charge, then fire a long piercing needle that ignores cover. Hitting a hunter shortens its cooldown.

weapons.quill_rifle: A steady auto rifle that loses punch on long strings, and hits Rattled foes harder.

passive.name: Fever
passive.desc: Each ability that lands (Burr Charge, its blast, Longneedle) adds a stack, up to 8, lasting 3.5s. Every stack makes your damage heal you for 6%, rifle included. A Burr Charge counts twice, once when it sticks and once when it goes off. Knocking a hunter down heals a quarter of your health and refreshes Slipstep.

dash.name: Slipstep
dash.desc: Tap: a quick 3.4m skid. Hold: a 6m low slide you can shoot from; let go early and part of the cooldown comes back. A knock refreshes it.

variants.tap: Lob a burr 11m. On a hunter or monster it sticks, then pops after 0.7s: 13 damage in 1.9m and Rattled for 1.2s.
variants.full: On a wall it blasts a cone back out: 10 damage, a hard shove, Rattled for 2s; a hunter shoved into more terrain is stunned, and the Burr Charge's cooldown drops 40%.

e.name: Longneedle
e.desc: Stand and charge for 0.8s (slowed, a lane shows), then fire a needle of light 14m that passes through cover and everything in its line: 36 damage, 20% more on a Rattled foe, and a Rattled hunter hit is Skewered. Hitting a hunter takes 30% off its cooldown.

rank3.sec: resets when you knock a hunter
rank3.dash: a burst of speed for 2s when a slide ends
rank3.kin: every hunter hit takes 30% off the cooldown

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 9s -> 6s; resets when you knock a hunter.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 11.5s -> 8.5s; +25% speed for 2s when a slide ends.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 12s -> 9s, damage +40%; every hunter hit takes 30% off the cooldown.

tells.half: a ring of Fever pips over the hat
tells.full: a full ring of eight pips and a heat shimmer
